correctness.rationale: At a selected endpoint v of an active edge uv, with at most one other active neighbor w, triangle inequality gives ||(x_v+x_u+x_w)/3-x_u||≤(ε+2ε)/3=ε; with only uv it halves. Other vertex updates cannot alter uv. Conversely a degree-k≥3 star with neighbor opinions (-ε,ε,...,ε) and center 0 moves center to (k-2)ε/(k+1), breaking negative edge immediately. Expanding squared-graph energy under a one-site update gives (d_v+2)/(d_v+1)^2||(Lx)_v||² exactly. For C_n this is 4/9, averaged over uniform site gives decrease 4/(9n)||Lx||² and λ_2(C_n)=4sin²(π/n), so q_n=1-16sin²(π/n)/(9n); first Fourier mode scaled to all-active state attains. Markov on energy gives stated hitting-time tail; finite local rational checks separately reproduced formula.
